title: No Overworld Generation
description: This project makes the overworld spawn void chunks, good for custom maps and such that you dont want to generate more default chunks
body:
# NoWorldGen

**NoWorldGen** is a simple Minecraft mod (Fabric, 1.21.11 only) that completely removes natural overworld terrain generation. With NoWorldGen, **all newly generated areas in the overworld will be empty void**—no terrain or structures will appear.

This makes NoWorldGen ideal for:
- Custom maps where you need the overworld to stay void except for what you build or import
- Premade maps that require strict control over world boundaries
- Servers or creative projects where you don't want any new terrain beyond your provided content

> **Supported Minecraft Version:** Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11 only
